title: Professional Email Renewals, Instalments and Expiry Standard
content:
Billing standard for Professional Email renewal charges, monthly instalments, declined attempts and the renewal of an expired subscription.

## 1. When a renewal or instalment may be charged

A renewal or instalment may be charged only while the subscription status is active, suspended or expired. The status is read from the subscription record of the subscription being charged.

## 2. Seat price and scheduled changes

> **Former clause, no longer in force:** renewals and instalments use the product's current seat price for the billing plan, fixed for the whole annual term where the product protects its price for the term, and apply any scheduled seat count and scheduled product at the renewal.

Clause now in force: every renewal and instalment other than a reactivation renewal, a term renewal or an annual conversion uses the product's current seat price for the billing plan, fixed for the whole annual term where the product protects its price for the term, and applies any scheduled seat count and scheduled product at the renewal; a reactivation renewal, a term renewal and an annual conversion are each priced as its own rule states.

## 3. Instalments and monthly renewals

> **Former clause, no longer in force:** an annual term billed monthly is charged a monthly instalment on the instalment day each month, and a monthly plan renews each month.

Clause now in force: an annual term billed monthly is charged a monthly instalment on the instalment day each month, and a monthly plan renews each month until an annual conversion moves it to the annual prepaid plan, which then starts a 12-month term on the annual start date the annual conversion sets.

## 4. Automatic renewal and declines

Where renewal is on, the first attempt runs on the product's first-attempt day before the term end date and retries run on each of the product's retry days before it; a scheduled cancellation stops renewal. The declined attempts of a billing cycle are those recorded on the subscription from the first attempt day of the charge due up to and including its due date.

## 5. Suspension for non-payment

An amount still unpaid the product's payment grace days, in calendar days, after its due date suspends the subscription the next day. Example (hypothetical, grace of 7 days): an instalment due on 4 May and still unpaid on 11 May suspends the subscription on 12 May.

## 6. Renewing an expired subscription

An expired subscription may be renewed only on or before the expired date plus the product's expired grace days, in calendar days. The window adds whole calendar days to the expired date, counting the next day as day 1, and the last day is included; the renewed term starts on the original term end date. The expired date is read from the subscription record.

| Hypothetical case, grace of 15 days, expired date 10 June | Renewal |
|---|---|
| Renewed on 25 June (day 15) | allowed; the new term starts on the original term end date |
| Renewed on 26 June (day 16) | not allowed |

superseded_clauses: Renewals and instalments use the product's current seat price for the billing plan, fixed for the whole annual term where price_protected_for_term is true, and apply any scheduled seat count and scheduled product at the renewal.
An annual term billed monthly is charged a monthly_instalment on the instalment day each month (instalment_day_rule), and a monthly plan renews each month.
